package.name: rover_modbus_driver
package.description:
Synchronous Modbus TCP client for the rover: the discrete contact/coil port, the retrying client that speaks it, and the POSIX TCP transport behind it.
Library only - no bridge node. Unlike the other rover_transport packages this one exposes no topics, because its consumer (the ros2_control safety controller) needs in-process calls rather than a topic round-trip on the e-stop path. See README.md.
Extracted from rover_hardware_interface, where it was linked PRIVATE and could not be reused by any other package.
